Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.driver

Class DiwanErrorCodes

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.driver.DiwanErrorCodes
@Internal public final class DiwanErrorCodes extends Object
The table that maps a failure kind to its stable Diwan error code.

The rows are in precedence order: when a failure has several kinds, the code of the first row whose kind is present wins. Codes are public API and are never renumbered or reused.

API Note:
Internal: the table is read through DiwanError; only the codes are public.
